formal_statement: ∃ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),   x1.size ≤ (64 : ℕ) ∧     PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (26 : ℕ) x1 ∧       (∀ x2 ∈ x1.gates, x2.inputs.Nodup) ∧         (∀ (x2 x3 : Fin (13 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn fun (x4 : Fin ((13 : ℕ) + (13 : ℕ))) => Fin.addCases x2 x3 x4) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x3 x4 = Bool.true ∧ (x2 x4 || x2 (x4 + (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ))) || x2 (x4 + (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ))) || x2 (x4 + (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ)))) = Bool.true) ∧           ∃ (x2 : ℕ) (x3 : ℕ) (x4 : ℕ),             x1.output = (26 : ℕ) + x2 ∧               x1.gates[x2]? = Option.some { op := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, inputs := [x3, x4] : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate } ∧                 ∀ (x5 : Bool),                   have x6 : List Bool := x1.wires (List.ofFn fun (x6 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (↑x6 = if x5 = Bool.true then (13 : ℕ) else (0 : ℕ)));                   x6.getD x3 Bool.false = Bool.false ∧ x6.getD x4 Bool.false = Bool.false
plain_statement: Plane of order 3 as in the parent: some AND/OR circuit of at most 64 gates, each reading two distinct earlier wires, computes incidence and has as output an AND of wires a and b, each false at the input with only x0 on and at the input with only y0 on.
